description: Sends a request for access to the Empath Legal team on a lawyer's behalf. Required: the lawyer's name and the email they will sign up with; optional: firm, venues and general kind of case. Use this when the lawyer asks you to request access for them; ask them first and send only what they agree to. Not for anything about a client, case, juror or document. It grants nothing: the answer says approval is pending.

inputSchema.description: The context a calling agent can supply for its user. Every field is plain text, length-capped and general.

case_type.description: The general kind of matter they would use the product for (for example civil or criminal).
case_type.title: Case Type

email.description: The email address the lawyer will sign up with; it identifies the request.
email.title: Email

firm.description: The lawyer's firm or practice name.
firm.title: Firm

venues.description: Where the lawyer tries cases, as states or counties.
venues.title: Venues

inputSchema.title: AccessRequestInput
